scope: Original-source finite-table/asset/predicate validation, not native gameplay or all-seed world generation
limitations: No generated world, monster, key, flag, WRAM/SRAM or CPU state is injected or synthesized.
LCG calculations below are host-side mathematical checks, not executions of the native runtime.
Full generator topology, placement and event correctness for all seeds is not proven by valid source pointers.
Individual simple rejection predicates are bounded; the outer variable-length generator restart is not proven to terminate for every seed.
CGB attribute assets are decoded below, but rendered attributes/palettes and collision semantics need gameplay evidence.
AOT completeness is entry-address coverage, not an assertion that every translated opcode/path has been dynamically tested.

records_hex: 05 03 03 ff ff ff ff ff ff ff ff 00 00 00 00 00

rng_math.mathematical_reason: Increment11 is odd and multiplier5 is1 mod4 (full-period conditions for a power-of-two modulus)
rng_math.not_proven: End-to-end generator termination/distribution over all seeds; variable call counts and layout rejection are not one fixed single-draw predicate.

persistence_bounds.cache_full_behavior: Allocator returnsFFC6=FF; generation4001 returns before assigning/writing a new slot.
persistence_bounds.reentry_behavior: Existing marker50+slot is required; descriptor is loaded, not regenerated from the seed.
persistence_bounds.delete_behavior: Original18:$69B0 invalidates cached marker and compacts all remaining4-byte records and2-byte seeds; adjusts selected index when needed.

aot.manifest_comparison_semantics: Exact file hash or exact hash after LF->CRLF Windows-checkout conversion; no other content normalization.
aot.runtime_policy: Compiled Bank0/ROMX entries and signature-checked original HRAM DMA only; other RAM execution traps.
aot.finding: No postgame-specific missing ROMX bank or reachable-entry filter in the full build. Dynamic correctness of every postgame path remains a gameplay-validation question.

surface_assets.dictionary_wrap_model: Original per-byte4KB normalization; outside-destination bytes arezero; true forward references inside destination aremarked unknown.

interior_assets.caveat: Mode4/5 multi-floor layouts are built from these assets; this validates assets, not every composite layout.

dungeon_layouts.caveat: Stair-ID compatibility and source/map bounds are checked; no claim of complete collision reachability, overlays or dynamic boss execution for all generated floor sequences.

map_compression.extended_counter_semantics: 8bit ADD19; zero executes256 copies, values beyond255 wrap before the loop
map_compression.model: For each copied byte normalize source index to12bits; sources outside the complete360-byte output window emit zero. Source indices within that window but ahead of emitted data are explicitly unknown, never invented as valid tiles.
